description: Λίστα παρόχων Ηλεκτρονικών Επικοινωνιών με δικαίωμα αριθμοδότησης is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by EETT. List of Electronic Services Providers holding a General Licence to whom numbering rights have been granted and who are registered in the Registry of Companies and Licences of EETT. Coverage: EETT. The portal shows the English title as "List of Electronic Communication Providers with Numbering Rights" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is EETT. Its keywords include αριθμοδότηση, Ηλεκτρονικές επικοινωνίες. The listing shows 1 download or service links in JSON. The listing shows 2026-07-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
